name: partner-analytics-commercial-readback
executionConcern: Partner selected-Store analytics semantic, authorization, freshness/provenance and commercial readback
objective: Make Partner performance/commercial readback explicitly Store-scoped or explicitly Partner-wide at one server-authorized contract, eliminate the current selected-Store mismatch, and keep analytics/read models non-authoritative for underlying DSH/WLT truth.
truthOwner: DSH owns operational facts/projections; WLT owns financial facts/projections; analytics only reads canonical facts and never owns business/financial truth.

tasks.objective: Resolve the reproduced selected-Store Partner analytics contract mismatch
tasks.currentProblem: PartnerAnalyticsInsightsPanel receives/displays canonicalStoreId and reloads on it, but fetchPartnerPerformance sends period only and handlePartnerPerformance independently resolves a Store through partnerStore.
tasks.requiredChange: Choose one canonical semantic: add selected Store intent to the API with server-side Partner/Store authorization, or make the endpoint explicitly Partner-wide/default-Store and remove selected-Store claims/dependencies. Update OpenAPI/generated clients/backend/tests and directly affected Partner/operator consumers; remove the abandoned semantic after migration.
tasks.targetState: For multi-Store Partners, every displayed performance metric has one explicit authorized scope that exactly matches the backend result; no client Store ID is trusted as authorization and no stale UI parameter falsely implies scope.
tasks.action: Reproduce with a multi-Store Partner; inspect Product Truth/current API conventions; implement the semantic at contract/backend owner; add cross-Store negative and correct aggregation/default tests; migrate consumers; remove obsolete parameter/copy/route/schema remnants; rerun contract/runtime checks.
mustNotChange: Do not trust arbitrary client Store IDs as authorization.
Do not silently aggregate multiple Stores while labeling one selected Store.
Do not fix only UI copy/refetch while backend scope remains different.
Do not turn analytics into a writer.
Do not broaden unrelated platform analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-Store Partner analytics scope is explicit in API/UI/backend and server-authorized.
Unauthorized Store intent fails closed without cross-Store disclosure if selected-Store model is used.
Partner-wide/default semantics are explicitly labeled and obsolete canonicalStoreId dependence is removed if that model is chosen.
OpenAPI/generated clients/backend tests/Partner and affected operator consumers remain aligned.
No stale alternative semantic remains after cleanup.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused analytics contract/consumer change while preserving canonical DSH facts; never restore ambiguous selected-Store presentation.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U008 contract/backend/consumer change set after multi-Store semantics and negatives pass.

tasks.objective: Close metric freshness/provenance and commercial/financial readback behavior
tasks.currentProblem: Even after scope correction, a read model can mislead if stale/missing/partial data renders as zero/current success or if financial/commercial values are locally derived without WLT provenance/currency/window semantics.
tasks.requiredChange: Make loading/empty/partial/offline/error/freshness explicit; keep financial facts WLT-backed; ensure generated/window/source semantics are preserved in Partner and directly compatible operator readback.
tasks.targetState: Every Partner metric is a truthful projection with explicit source/window/freshness and no fabricated zero/current state; analytics cannot mutate source truth.
tasks.action: Exercise no data/stale/partial/offline/error and current data cases; repair read-model state mapping/provenance; verify financial values originate from WLT-backed projection and remove local derived truth if found.
mustNotChange: Do not render missing/stale financial data as zero/current success.
Do not calculate authoritative wallet/settlement values in DSH/frontend.
Do not mutate operational state from analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Financial/commercial values retain WLT-backed source/currency/unit semantics.
Analytics remains read-only and affected operator readback stays contract-compatible.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused presentation/read-model changes without changing underlying DSH/WLT facts.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep freshness/provenance changes within the same U008 read-model boundary.
